properties.digitization_method: ADDED 2026-09-19 for Mission Bay's third real-buildings pass (remaining uncovered footprints inside the official Mission Bay North/South redevelopment-area boundary): 1700 Owens St, a UCSF-affiliated research building at the west corner of Owens Street housing the UCSF-Bay Area Center for AIDS Research (CFAR) and the Taube-Koret Center for Huntington's Disease Research. 2026-09-29 accuracy audit: tenant sourcing: the CFAR page cited above is only an event-location tag listing CFAR events held at 1700 Owens Street, so it does not show that CFAR is housed there, and 'UCSF-affiliated' rests on those events plus the Assessor/permit record (the permit calls it a research and development building). The Taube-Koret Center for Huntington's Disease Research is a Gladstone Institutes program (established March 2009); Gladstone's own center site has a contact page, undated, that lists it as 'located in the 1700 building' at 1700 Owens Street, now cited; whether it is still there is not confirmed. 2026-10-02: public-text pass. accuracy_caveat, notes reworded for readers (meaning unchanged; no change to the shape, status, use or geometry_type); previous wording -- accuracy_caveat: 'REAL -- surveyed DataSF Building Footprints outline (mblr SF8709007), cross-referenced by position against an OpenStreetMap building/address point (way 27955297) for the name and street address; not a hand trace or plan estimate. Construction date: DBI permit 200412282235 (research and development building at 1700 Owens) completed 2007-10-02 and the Assessor roll for 2009-2021 gives year built 2007; architect not confirmed by any source found in this pass.'; notes: 'Construction: DBI permit 200412282235 completed 2007-10-02 and Assessor year built 2007 (roll years 2009-2021); architect not confirmed by any source found in this pass.'.
